title: code-forge gate.yaml schema
$comment: Loader-only constraints: (a) at most one entry may set default: true (cross-item, enforced by loader). (b) outlet value 'cli' is a deprecated alias for 'subprocess'; intentionally excluded from this enum because it is not a canonical value. Note: load_gate_config does NOT validate the outlet field (gate_check.py ignores it); alias resolution happens via resolve_outlet (outlet_resolver.py:53 _DEPRECATED_OUTLET_ALIASES) called from the cli runtime path, not from the config loader.

outlet.description: Review dispatch method. subprocess: spawns a fresh subprocess per pass (default; requires a configured backend). inline: runs review in the current session. subagent: spawns a fresh Agent per pass. sampling: MCP only, borrows the IDE client's model.

backends.description: Named review backends, keyed by backend name. Select with FORGE_BACKEND=<name>.

test.description: Test command configuration for the R1 commit gate (code-forge gate-check).

command.description: Test runner command as a list. First element must be a known runner (pytest, python, python3, cargo, go, make, npm, npx, node).

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the test run. Default: 120.

env.description: Extra environment variables to set when running the test command.

cwd.description: Working directory for the test command. Default: repo root.

source_patterns.description: List of glob patterns. Gate skips if no staged file matches any pattern.

non_ascii.description: Non-ASCII detection mode. ai-smell (default): blocks confusable typographic characters only. strict: blocks every non-ASCII byte.

presubmit.description: External linters run on staged diffs before the test gate.

applies_to.description: Glob pattern for files this entry applies to.

on.description: Input format passed to the linter command.

when_exists.description: Skip this entry if the specified file does not exist.

db_path.description: Override path to the graph.db file.

siblings.description: Cross-repo sibling repositories for joint review. Each entry specifies a local repo path and a ref range.

repo.description: Path to the sibling repository (local only in v1; no remote URLs).

ref.description: Git ref range in baseline..head format (e.g. main..feature-x).

label.description: Label for this sibling in review output. Defaults to basename of repo path.

enabled.description: Enable or disable daemon_state detection. Omit to disable.

subsystem.description: The subsystem that owns the state.

mutates.description: The state artifact that is mutated.

interferes_with.description: The other subsystem that is interfered with.

conflicts_file.description: Path to an external YAML file containing conflict triplets.

canary.description: Opt-in canary laziness check for the inline review outlet.

enabled.description: Activate the canary check (equivalent to --canary CLI flag).

n.description: Number of canary mutations to plant per review.

threshold_ratio.description: Minimum fraction of canaries the reviewer must catch.

retry.description: HTTP-level retry configuration for API backends. Omit to use defaults (5 attempts, 2s initial delay).

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts per API call (including the first).

initial_delay_s.description: Initial delay in seconds before first retry. Doubles each attempt.

type.description: Backend type. 'api' for direct HTTP; 'cli' for claude subprocess.

format.description: API format. Required for type=api. 'anthropic', 'openai', or 'vertex'.

command.description: CLI binary name or path. For type=cli only. Default: 'claude'.

model.description: Model ID. Optional for both types. Omit to use session default.

max_tokens.description: Output token cap for API calls. Default: 16384.

base_url.description: API base URL. Required for type=api with format=anthropic or format=openai.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key. Required for format=anthropic or format=openai. Never put the key value here.

project_id.description: GCP project ID. Required for format=vertex.

region.description: GCP region for Vertex AI. Optional; omit for global.

credentials_path.description: Path to a service account JSON key file. Optional for format=vertex.

default.description: Mark this backend as the config default. At most one entry may set this to true.
